title: Repository census
description: Class (c) artefact: derived from the source tree, not a specoment projection and not accumulated state. See SD-013. This schema is WP-V1-CENSUS-001 carry-in 1, which that package did not deliver.

disposition.description: The closed vocabulary, verbatim from the specoment. 'undecided' is deliberately absent: it occurs zero times in the specoment, and admitting it would readmit the state the XOR rule exists to prevent.

escalation.description: An OD-* id present in state.json. Existence is checked in Rust; this constrains only the shape.

judged.description: A row that carries judgement. disposition and escalation are never both non-null: that is the XOR, and its absence would readmit 'undecided' under another name. Both-null is permitted only while WP-V1-CENSUS-001/-002 measure; WP-V1-CENSUS-003 tightens this to exactly-one when it assigns, and until it does this schema does NOT reject a row with no judgement at all. Applied to every section that carries these fields — all ten. The first draft of this schema omitted generated_files and ci_rows, which reproduced inside the artefact the very error it was written to fix: CENSUS-001 claimed 'every row' and was wrong for 104. next_phase may be null only when the row names an unresolved OD-* whose question covers the missing phase - WP-V1-CENSUS-003 shape 3, a disposition whose owning phase is open. Without that gate a null in a required field is undecided returning through the one field the XOR never covered.

phase_pending.description: The unresolved OD-* that will supply this row next phase. Shape 3 in WP-V1-CENSUS-003: a disposition whose owning phase is open. Required because no existing field could carry the id - escalation is forbidden by the XOR when disposition is set, and next_phase is the field being left null.

judged.$comment: WP-V1-CENSUS-003 step 7 replaces this object entire not/description pair with the block below, which expresses the whole row-validity rule set at once: {"anyOf": [{"properties": {"disposition": {"not": {"type": "null"}}}, "required": ["disposition"]}, {"properties": {"escalation": {"not": {"type": "null"}}}, "required": ["escalation"]}], "not": {"allOf": [{"properties": {"disposition": {"not": {"type": "null"}}}, "required": ["disposition"]}, {"properties": {"escalation": {"not": {"type": "null"}}}, "required": ["escalation"]}]}, "if": {"properties": {"next_phase": {"type": "null"}}, "required": ["next_phase"]}, "then": {"anyOf": [{"properties": {"phase_pending": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^OD-[0-9]{3}$"}}, "required": ["phase_pending"]}, {"properties": {"escalation": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^OD-[0-9]{3}$"}}, "required": ["escalation"]}]}, "else": {"properties": {"phase_pending": {"type": "null"}}}} Notes. anyOf plus not gives exactly-one; the current schema carries only the not half, so "neither set" is accepted today and would have stayed accepted after activation if only the next_phase conditional had been drafted. Every branch constrains the VALUE, not the key: required alone is satisfied by a key that is present and null, and this generator emits every field, which made an earlier then branch vacuous - it accepted next_phase null with phase_pending null, the state the gate exists to forbid. then is an anyOf over phase_pending and escalation because an escalated row may also have an unknowable phase: the decision it names may itself determine which phase acts. That is shape 4, and it needs no separate field because escalation already names the unresolved record. Verified against jsonschema 0.33: four legal shapes accepted, five invalid combinations rejected, and all 1801 rows fail today by design because every row is neither-set during measurement. The unresolved half - the named record must exist and be unresolved in state.json - is not expressible here and goes in Rust.

public_types.description: Items matched by a column-0 `pub <kind>` predicate under each crate's src/. Known exclusions, stated here rather than only in a Rust doc comment: macro-generated public types (3 known, including UiNodeId) have no row; named re-exports `pub use path::{A, B}` are counted neither as declared nor re-exported; `pub(crate)` is correctly excluded. Carried to WP-V1-CENSUS-003 — see census.json limitations.

dependencies.description: Declared direct third-party dependencies only (18). The lockfile resolves 494 packages; the transitive remainder is NOT inventoried here and OD-006's LEGAL-005 provenance question covers all 494, not these 18. Recorded as a limitation, not a claim.

edges.description: Exempt by construction: an edge is a measured fact about the graph, not a thing with a disposition. CENSUS-001 asserted 'every row' carries the invariant and was wrong for these 96 plus the 8 layers; the exemption is declared here rather than left silent.
